Event-Driven Systems: What Kafka Actually Solves

Event-Driven Systems: What Kafka Actually Solves

31 Jan 2026

Kafka is often introduced as a performance tool. That’s misleading.

The real value of Kafka is decoupling.

In production systems, direct service-to-service communication:

  • Increases coordination costs
  • Creates cascading failures
  • Makes deployments risky

Using Kafka shifted the system from: “Who is calling me?” to “What events happened?”

That change:

  • Reduced tight coupling
  • Improved observability
  • Made failures easier to reason about

Kafka didn’t remove complexity. It moved it to a place where it could be managed.

That’s the trade-off.
